submitter: bugfix-220 lane — ROUND 2, resubmit of corr def4441c (REVISE, gating objection from bug_historian)
rationale: ROUND 2. Round 1 returned REVISE on bug_historian's HIGH objection; both of that seat's catches were REAL and are now FIXED IN CODE, committed e55cbfa64 (the round-1 code was already on the shared branch as a60a13cbb + gofmt 03433f4b5 with a Council-Submitted trailer, per the commit-the-moment-coherent rule). Every objection answered below, checked rather than argued. (1) bug_historian e1 HIGH — FIXED: a valid uuid matching no row was the {found:false} soft miss, which routes the saga through the success-labelled complete_error path, the exact silent no-op shape this input exists to close. loadPageRecordByID now returns a FATAL error naming the input and both ids; the new test TestLoadPageRecord_AuthoritativeIDMatchingNoRowIsFatal pins BOTH halves — the error, and via sqlmock ExpectationsWereMet that the zero-row id lookup is the one and only query issued, so a silent name fallback cannot reappear without failing it. (2) bug_historian e3 MEDIUM — FIXED: both presence checks now use position($2 in COALESCE(rendered_html,'')) > 0 — a plain substring test with no pattern semantics and no escaping subtleties — replacing the LIKE-concatenation of the raw href ('_' is a wildcard and hrefs routinely carry underscores; an over-match refuses a genuinely resolved item). The code comment names the class and NOTES THE SIBLING: VerifyDeadFragmentLinkResolved in check_phantom_internal_links_fragments.go still carries the LIKE shape — that verifier is an active lane's (dead_fragment_link); flagged in the comment and in bugs_open/220's related section rather than edited under them. (3) editquality e3 MEDIUM (the multiple-producers check, source-level as the seat specified) — run: grep -rn 'unbuilt_internal_link' --include=*.go platform/ internal/ pkg/ excluding tests returns hits in exactly TWO files. check_phantom_internal_links.go is the ONLY minting path (the arm at :145-155 sets the fields, WorkItemSpec{ItemType: f.IssueType} at :166-179 is the single write). check_phantom_internal_links_fragments.go's hits are comments plus a deliberate NON-producing branch: its rule-3 arm explicitly `continue`s when the path is in targets.unbuilt — quoting its own header, 'a phantom path is reported once, as a phantom, and an unbuilt target is reported once, as unbuilt_internal_link. One href never produces two findings.' Corroborating (not primary, per the seat's own caveat about free-text created_by): SELECT created_by, count(*) FROM site_work_items WHERE item_type='unbuilt_internal_link' GROUP BY 1 → completeness-discovery-agent|13, one row. ONE producer, at source and in data. (4) editquality e8 LOW (ledger) — the numbers were free and are now TAKEN BY THIS LANE: schema_migrations rows quoted in grounded_in (both applied_by='record-only' with verification notes; applied by hand and read back before recording, 2026-08-08 18:13/18:14 UTC). (5) guardian e7 MEDIUM (config_change bookkeeping) — edit 7 below now declares per-surface ownership explicitly: it is a CONFIG CHANGE to agent_definitions rows build-dispatch-loop (build dispatch pipeline; consumers = every handler that loop dispatches) and page-build-handler (content pipeline). Consumers were told: dated CONTRIB notes in work_item_completion_integrity/NOTES (verifier registry owner) and bugs_open/220 (the 206 lane's file). (6) guardian e1 LOW — the blast-radius claim is MEASURED and the council's own round-1 check confirmed it: 'page-build-handler | 1, tool-recreation-handler | 1' — exactly two live agents carry a load_page_record step; only page-build-handler's step config sets authoritative_page_id (mig 340, read back live); tool-recreation-handler's step is untouched and the byte-for-byte name-first test pins the default path. (7) debug_historian e7 MEDIUM — the seat read the round-1 sketch, which showed only the UPDATEs; the FILE has the discipline asked for: a $pre$ DO block that RAISEs if the call_handler mapping already carries 'page_id?' (so a re-run is an EXCEPTION, not a repeat UPDATE), RAISEs if the page_name? mapping has drifted from the expected current string, and RAISEs if load_page_record already carries authoritative_page_id; plus a $post$ DO block reading back both keys and RAISE-ing on mismatch (a SELECT-only verify cannot stop the COMMIT). Conceded honestly: no snapshot_agent call — same as precedent 336; the recovery path is the _ROLLBACK sidecar, which is the exact inverse (#- of the two added keys) rather than a whole-config restore, and the $pre$ guard documents the expected pre-state it was applied against. (8) debug_historian eNone MEDIUM (pod verification) — named in the lane RUNBOOK and repeated here as the acceptance contract: after the owner's next fleet roll, pod-grep 'authoritative_page_id' on EVERY replica (positive control); this change removes no string so no negative control exists — per the WII-009 precedent the substitute for a purely additive change is the dated BEFORE measurement (0 on the pre-roll image) plus the behavioural half: fire the one-shot improvement loop at a site with a live link to a never-deployed page; the item must build the page its page_id column names, complete with result._verification.status='verified', and curl -sI on the target must return 200. (9) prior_art_librarian e7 MEDIUM — the zero-history claim now has its verbatim reads in grounded_in (both queries returned 0). (10) prior_art_librarian e5 LOW — the literal_markdown removal precedent quoted verbatim in grounded_in from verifier_coverage_test.go. (11) prior_art_librarian e1 LOW — the on-point landmine was AUTHORED BY THIS LANE in the same commit (a60a13cbb) from this bug's own mechanism; its full text carries no tool-recreation-handler caveat beyond what edits 1-2 already honour (that agent's step untouched; name-first default pinned by test). ORIGINAL RATIONALE (round 1, unchanged in substance): the phantom-links check files unbuilt_internal_link against the TARGET page via the item's page_id column, but build-dispatch-loop's call_handler forwards only spec.page_name (the CONTAINER) and load_page_record resolves name-first — so every dispatch rebuilt the container, reported success, completed, and was re-minted next discovery pass: a convergence-free green loop, live-reproduced twice on 2026-08-08. Fix: forward the column (site-work-orchestrator's own mapping shape, mig 340); give it opt-in authority via authoritative_page_id on load_page_record (RFC_010 §2 — an opt-in field, not a priority flip); register VerifyUnbuiltInternalLinkResolved fail-closed, judged by the detector's own NeverDeployedPagePredicate, with the claim-timeout exclusion lockstep both halves (declared list + mig 341). Candidate 4 (route by target page_type) deferred on record in the bug file. Register WII-012.

edits.rationale: Round 1 edit 1 plus the HIGH fix: loadPageRecordByID now treats zero rows as a fatal error — the id came from the work item's page_id column, so no-row means deleted/foreign target, and a {found:false} soft miss would route the saga through the success-labelled complete_error path. Malformed uuid was already fatal; both failure shapes of the new input are now loud, and the absent case is byte-for-byte the old behaviour.

New test for the HIGH fix: TestLoadPageRecord_AuthoritativeIDMatchingNoRowIsFatal asserts the error AND, via ExpectationsWereMet on a mock armed with exactly one zero-row id query, that no second (name) query is issued — the silent fallback cannot reappear without failing this.

Round 1 edit 3 plus the MEDIUM fix: both presence checks use position($2 in COALESCE(rendered_html,'')) > 0 instead of LIKE-concatenating the raw href — '_' is a SQL wildcard and an over-match would refuse a genuinely resolved item. Producer question settled at source: this file's arm is the only minting path for the item type; the fragments arm explicitly continues on an unbuilt target (its header: 'One href never produces two findings'). The sibling dead_fragment verifier still carries the LIKE shape — named in the comment for its owning lane, not edited under them.
